body.name: Measurable full-sample rank profile
body.construction: \(Q_F(\beta)=\|Y-\beta D\|_F^2-\sum_{j=1}^{r+1}s_j(Y-\beta D)^2\) and \(\widehat\beta_F=\min\operatorname*{argmin}_{\beta\in\mathcal B}Q_F(\beta)\). After this scalar selection, \(\widehat L_F\) is the row-major lexicographically smallest best rank-\(r+1\) approximation; \(\widehat U\) and \(\widehat V\) use the stated lexicographic completion rule.
